items.title: CMU robotics facilities open to IROS 2026 attendees in Pittsburgh
items.summary_en: According to search-result snippets, hundreds of academics and industry leaders toured CMU robotics and engineering facilities on Oct. 1 during IROS 2026. RI's Howie Choset was general chair, and the conference was reportedly last held in Pittsburgh in 1995. Demos reportedly included the AirLab's autonomous drones and the Soft Machines Lab's starfish-inspired robots.

items.title: CMU researchers selected for next round of DOE Genesis Mission awards, including RI's Jeff Schneider
items.summary_en: According to search snippets, CMU researchers were selected for the next round of DOE Genesis Mission awards. RI research professor Jeff Schneider will collaborate on a project led by Commonwealth Fusion Systems to build an AI-enabled digital twin of its SPARC fusion machine.
